title: Attention is the item that the consciousness model represents

statements.text: Selective attention passes the three tests: it is a physical process that affects neurons, reported consciousness reads as an abstracted description of it, and a century of data shows the two covary. AST proposes that attention is Item 1 and the attention schema is Item 2.

sources.quote: Attention is Item 1. It is a process of selectively enhancing some representations over others.
Attention appears to match the three diagnostic properties described above.
